title: neuradex chart values
description: Values for the neuradex Helm chart. Mirrors the inline documentation in values.yaml.

nameOverride.description: Partially override generated resource names (replaces the chart-name part only).

fullnameOverride.description: Fully override all generated resource names.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling the image from a private registry.

name.description: Name of the image pull secret.

replicaCount.description: Desired number of replicas. The service is stateless and safe to scale.

containerPort.description: Port the service binds to inside the container (LISTEN_ADDR=0.0.0.0:<containerPort>); the Service and probes target this port via the `http` named port.

tag.description: Image tag; falls back to the chart's appVersion when empty.

digest.description: Optional immutable digest pin ("sha256:..."); takes precedence over image.tag.

pullPolicy.description: Pull policy. Never is useful with kind clusters fed via kind load docker-image.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount; no API token is ever mounted.

name.description: ServiceAccount name; defaults to the release fullname when created, `default` otherwise.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing secret holding KAGI_SESSION_TOKEN. When set, kagiSessionToken is ignored and no Secret is created.

kagiSessionTokenKey.description: Key within the secret holding the token.

kagiSessionToken.description: Token value; only used when existingSecret is empty (the chart then creates the Secret). Prefer existingSecret in production.

port.description: Port exposed by the Service (targetPort is the http named port).

userAgent.description: Optional USER_AGENT override for the browser-impersonating HTTP client; empty uses the application default.

rustLog.description: RUST_LOG value consumed by the tracing EnvFilter (e.g. `info`, `neuradex=debug,hyper=warn`).

podAnnotations.description: Extra annotations on the Deployment's pod template.

podLabels.description: Extra labels on the Deployment's pod template.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext. Secure defaults match the distroless nonroot image (uid/gid 65532, RuntimeDefault seccomp).

containerSecurityContext.description: Container-level securityContext (no privilege escalation, capabilities dropped, read-only root filesystem).

resources.description: Resource requests/limits. The CPU limit is intentionally unset to avoid throttling.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe (full Kubernetes probe spec); defaults to GET /healthz on the http named port.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe (full Kubernetes probe spec); defaults to GET /healthz on the http named port.

enabled.description: Enable the default-deny style NetworkPolicy (ingress to containerPort; egress to DNS plus 80/443).
Enable an Ingress fronting the Service.

annotations.description: Extra annotations for the Ingress resource.

hpa.description: HorizontalPodAutoscaler (autoscaling/v2); when enabled, minReplicas overrides replicaCount.

pdb.description: PodDisruptionBudget; with a single replica, enabling this blocks all voluntary evictions.

topologySpreadConstraints.description: Topology spread constraints; a soft spread over kubernetes.io/hostname is recommended with replicaCount >= 2.

extraEnv.description: Additional env entries merged into the container environment (name/value or valueFrom).

resourceList.description: Kubernetes resource quantity map (e.g. cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi).
